messages:
ben: Heads-up from sales: ACME wants SSO + tenant routing in the pilot, not v1.

lina: That's a big ask. Do we have a plan to wedge this in without delaying public MVP?

omar: Possible if we scope SSO to a handshake-only implementation (no admin UI, no discovery). Tenant routing = header-based only.

nina: We'll need explicit cut candidates to make room. My list: promptstore UI polish, in-console billing breakdown, role admin UX.

ben: Proposal: fastpath pilot exceptions — a feature-flagged pilot build for ACME that doesn't change public MVP date. Pilot runs two weeks earlier.

lina: Ops/security dependencies?

eng-bot: Flagged: KMS integration check, security review SR-21, add SSO audit logs. Infra estimate: 2 infra-days + 1 oncall prep.

omar: Add rollback controls: feature-flag + canary 5% + emergency disable. Also need SSO smoke tests.

nina: Action items: 1) Omar to write minimal SSO acceptance criteria with test vectors (due Thu). 2) Ops to open infra tickets and tag milestone MLP-47 (due Wed). 3) Product to publish pilot-visible checklist for ACME (Ben/Lina, due Mon). 4) Sales to confirm ACME will accept minimal scope in writing (Sales-bot).

ben: Timeline note: public MVP unchanged (2024-03-31) if infra & security signoff by 3/15. Pilot earliest start 2024-03-18. If not, SSO stays in v1.

lina: +1 from product. Keep cuts surgical and documented.

omar: +1 eng. I'll post the acceptance doc in #docs when ready.

sales-bot: ACME PM acknowledged and asked for a clear pilot features checklist by Tue.
